sections.title: Vendored native components
entries: llama.cpp v0.8.0 (commit 8642541b255bfb5dc39cd351a178be09013a55d6, unmodified, vendored in third_party/llama.cpp and pinned by HARBOR_PIN.json; bound by core/harbor_llama_sys + core/harbor_llama) — MIT — © 2023-2026 The ggml authors — https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp. Used for on-device GGUF inference and the mtmd image/audio projectors.
xxHash 0.8.3 (vendored within llama.cpp, vendor/hash; media hashing in mtmd) — BSD-2-Clause — © 2012-2021 Yann Collet — https://github.com/Cyan4973/xxHash.
SHA-1 in C by Steve Reid and Crypto/Sha256.c by Igor Pavlov (vendored within llama.cpp, vendor/hash) — public domain.
rotate-bits (vendored within llama.cpp, vendor/hash) — MIT — © 2021 William Casarin.
nlohmann/json 3.12.0 (vendored within llama.cpp; JSON Schema parsing for structured output) — MIT — © 2013-2025 Niels Lohmann — https://github.com/nlohmann/json.

sections.title: Flutter / Dart components
entries: Flutter engine and framework (3.47.4 stable) — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/flutter/flutter. Distributed as the platform runtime, not modified by Harbor.
flutter_localizations and Dart 'packages' SDK libraries used by the app — BSD-3-Clause — https://github.com/flutter/flutter.
package:ffi and package:lints (Dart packages locked by pubspec.lock) — Apache-2.0 / BSD-3-Clause respectively — https://pub.dev.

sections.title: Fonts and design assets
entries: Platform system fonts only; Harbor does not bundle third-party font binaries. Harbor Current 2 design tokens are original to the project.
